purpose: Teach: アルク/ホース/ボディー/マリン/キッド/チャーリー/アドバンス/ブランチ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英語教材アルクのテキストを愛用されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer loves those Alc English learning textbooks.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. A small smile — the delight of noticing something about someone. Slow, gentle cadence, like sharing a small discovery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ガーデニングのホース、つまり水撒きホースを買われたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer bought a garden hose. For watering, you know.
lines.style: Soft confirmation, with a touch of fondness. Speaking as though filling in a detail Aoi would appreciate. Even pace, conversational.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、車のボディーカラー選びに悩まれてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer's having a hard time choosing a car color.
lines.style: Sympathetic understanding. Knowing nod in the voice. Slightly slower on 'hard time' — the gentle recognition of indecision. Warm without pushing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マリンスポーツがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer really loves marine sports.
lines.style: Bright recognition. Light emphasis on 'really' — genuine enthusiasm for what they like. Quick, engaged delivery, then a slight pause.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、漫画キャラの「キッド」のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer's a fan of Kid from the manga.
lines.style: Slightly playful, like sharing a fun fact. Casual tone, no judgment. Small smile underlying the words. Natural, easy rhythm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、チャップリンのチャーリーがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer loves Charlie Chaplin.
lines.style: Gentle appreciation in the voice. Treating the preference with respect — not quaint, but lovely. Even, thoughtful delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ゲームでアドバンス、つまりGBAの世代だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer's from the Game Boy Advance generation.
lines.style: Knowing tone, a touch wistful. The recognition of a shared era or cultural moment. Steady pace, trailing slightly on 'generation'.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、休日にブランチを楽しまれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer really enjoys brunching on days off.
lines.style: Warm, close observation. The comfort of noticing someone's small pleasures. Soft ending — intimate without being intrusive.
